metadata.description: A curated set of AI plugins for Happy Horizon teams — spanning Magento 2, Hyvä Theme, and the Horizon Storefront plugin, with room to extend each package with your own rules, skills, and workflows.

plugins.name: hyva-ai-tools
plugins.description: AI-powered skills for Magento 2 development with Hyvä Theme — Alpine components, CMS components and custom fields, child themes, modules, Tailwind compilation, Playwright tests, and more (vendored from hyva-themes/hyva-ai-tools)

plugins.name: magento2-development
plugins.description: Rules and best practices for Magento 2 development, plus skills for version upgrades (composer, CI/deploy PHP alignment, setup:di:compile, post-upgrade regression testing with browser E2E and PR artifacts), patching with cweagans/composer-patches, and migrating Magento Hypernode projects to GitHub Actions + deploy.settings.yml

plugins.name: horizon-storefront
plugins.description: Rules and skills for Horizon Storefront — storefront conventions, structure, and day-to-day development guidance for Happy Horizon teams.

plugins.name: horizon-frontend-foundations
plugins.description: Shared Next.js, React, and web stack skills and rules for all Horizon client projects — vendor content lives under synced-vendor-skills/ and is wired in via symlinks.
